subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this credential-routing PR require live TTS or Gateway proof for a file-source persona SecretRef before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The code path looks like the right shared fix and the prior P1 target gap is addressed, but the external PR changes provider credential routing and the PR body states the real TTS command was not tested with provider credentials.

options.title: Require Live SecretRef TTS Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal or log output from openclaw infer tts convert or an equivalent Gateway TTS call showing a persona-level file-source SecretRef resolves before provider use.

options.title: Override On Targeted Tests
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept collector, registry, command-target, and CI coverage without live provider proof, while owning the credential-routing risk.

options.title: Pause Until Optional TTS Startup Work Settles
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 is resolved if maintainers want to review all TTS SecretRef behavior together.

recommendation.title: Require Live SecretRef TTS Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal or log output from openclaw infer tts convert or an equivalent Gateway TTS call showing a persona-level file-source SecretRef resolves before provider use.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the merged SecretRef framework this PR extends, making them the strongest routing candidate for proof and target-scope judgment.
